source.stem: What is not a characteristic of all living organisms?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Unchewed boiled rice also gives little or no blue-black colour with iodine.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Saliva changes sugar into starch, so iodine turns darker after chewing.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Saliva changes the protein in egg white into sugar.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The faint blue-black colour proves that all the starch has changed into sugar.

intelligence.enrichment: Starchy food such as chapati or rice can taste sweet after chewing because saliva contains a digestive juice that breaks starch into sugar; chewed boiled rice shows little or no blue-black iodine colour because some starch has been changed. chewing mixes starchy food with saliva -> saliva acts on starch -> sugar forms and iodine colour becomes weaker The learner correctly applies this rule: Starchy food such as chapati or rice can taste sweet after chewing because saliva contains a digestive juice that breaks starch into sugar; chewed boiled rice shows little or no blue-black iodine colour because some starch has been changed. Chewed chapati tastes sweet only because chapati is naturally sweet, not because saliva changes starch.
